description: REST API with Copart auction lots (USA) in JSON: examples in curl, Python, JavaScript and PHP
rules: Send the key in the X-API-Key header; base URL https://api.apiauto.space/v1
Copart lots live in market=us together with IAAI lots
There is no source query parameter: keep records where source == 'copart' on your side
In the change feed, keep events whose car_id starts with 'copart:'
A page of market=us can hold no Copart lots: walk next_cursor, and sort=first_seen wasted the fewest records on 2 November 2026
Call the API from a server: CORS is off
Paginate with next_cursor; offset is not supported
Paid plans count every returned lot, including lots of the other auction; the demo key counts data requests and allows up to 20 cars per request
Photo links expire in about a day: store the lot id and fetch a fresh record
